We're proud to work with many incredible companies, accelerating their ability to build their products.

We've spent years watching talented engineering teams lose momentum to the same frustrating bottleneck: waiting. Waiting for CI to finish. Waiting for builds to complete. Waiting for tests to run.

After experiencing this pain firsthand at companies of every size, we set out to build the developer infrastructure platform we'd always wanted to use. Something that would seamlessly integrate with our workflows and the tools teams already love—but make everything dramatically faster and more cost-effective.

About Qorelo

Almost every company running SAP faces the same task: the transformation to S/4HANA. These programmes run for years, cost millions, and regularly stall at the same point — nobody fully understands the legacy landscape that has grown over decades.

That is where Qorelo comes in. Qorelo is an AI agent platform that integrates natively into your SAP landscape and deeply understands your business processes and workflows. Its agents read code, processes and documentation, surface requirements, map scope, and deliver the fit-to-standard analysis in weeks instead of months. jobs.description:

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. That needs an interface built for it.

getpress entwickelt eine eigene KI-Agenten-Plattform (LangGraph, PostgreSQL, Next.js) für die PR-Branche


Der Servicemarkt, von Legal über Consulting bis hin zu Agenturen, steht vor der größten Transformation der Geschichte. Gleichzeitig wird der milliardenschwere PR-Markt im Zeitalter von AI-Visibility gerade immer wichtiger. getpress, eine der am schnellsten wachsenden PR-Agenturen Deutschlands (>40 Leute, Kund*innen wie Trivago, Komoot, Fonio AI oder AutoScout24), hat sich entschieden, diesen Wandel zu führen statt abzuwarten. Wir bauen die PR Company der Zukunft: keine reine Service-Company mehr, sondern eine Service-as-a-Software-Company.
